confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and dorm anchors are moderately reliable. Private hostel, 1-star and 3-star room rates vary widely by neighbourhood, and July winter low-season and school-holiday demand are not verified. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.3 times beer, wine glass about 1.2 times beer) because direct recall of Cape Town bar prices is weaker. The FX figure comes from search-result snippets of rba.gov.au pages, not from an opened RBA data table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates reflect Cape Town's own mix of local eateries, guesthouses and hostels, treated as a tourist-heavy Southern African urban market.
